inputs.share_count_basis: fully diluted: 616,871,882 ordinary shares on issue at 30-Sep-2025 (note 3-4) + 3,288,200 dilutive Performance Share Rights (note 1-5) = 620.16m; held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). NOT the 627.4m diluted WANOS -- that is a year-average that overstates the divisor after A$853.5m of FY2025 buybacks. Buybacks continued after balance date (~A$166m remaining of the A$750m program at 30-Sep-2025), so the live count is likely ~2-3m lower; refresh from the FY2026 filing.
inputs.sbc_source: ALL.AX_Annual_FY2025.txt:5643 share-based payments expense A$67.5m (cash-flow add-back A$68.3m at :5310); no separate equity-award tax line -- awards are satisfied by shares bought by the employee share trust (A$123.5m in FY2025, financing), which is the cash mechanism holding the count flat and is treated as value-neutral like the buyback
inputs.interest_income_note: Not stripped: the company is net DEBT (A$423m ex-leases), so there is no cash pile being double-counted. Reported FCF is a post-net-interest figure (A$127.8m paid, A$58.1m received); the component build is unlevered so the projections are before either.
inputs.buyback_note: Actual financing outflow FY2025 A$853.5m (12,509,867 shares cancelled); FY2024 A$837.4m. A$1.85bn program completed; A$750m program announced Feb-2025 with A$584m bought by 30-Sep-2025. The flat share count is fully funded -- the company repurchases ~12x its SBC each year.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and quote are both AUD, but the large majority of profit is USD-denominated (Gaming NA US$2.02bn of revenue). Company sensitivity: US 1 cent move in AUD/USD = ~A$27m NPATA (~1.7%). FY2025 carried an A$47m NPATA translational tailwind from AUD weakness. This model holds FX flat at FY2025 average rates; a 5c AUD appreciation would cut base IV by roughly A$3.5-4/share. Reader should re-check the AUD/USD level against ~0.65 when refreshing.
inputs.wacc_rationale: AUD-built: AU 10yr government ~4.4% risk-free + 5.0% ERP x beta ~1.1 = ~9.9% cost of equity; pre-tax cost of debt ~4.0% (Term Loan A at 3-month SOFR + spread, 50% swapped at 3.21%) = ~2.9% after tax; debt ~4% of EV -> WACC ~9.6%, rounded to 9.5%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: risk is carried in the flows and weights, not the rate (section 7f).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (dcf-methods routing table: operating company, non-US, moderately cyclical -> owner-fcf.md + section 7). Reason: Aristocrat is a cash-generative operating company (gaming content/hardware, social casino, online RMG) with modest net debt; FCF is the value driver. Not a bank/REIT/LIC. LEASES: treatment (B) -- lease principal (A$44.8m) + lease interest (A$20.7m) charged in the flows as lease_cost_pct 1.04% of revenue, lease liabilities (A$325.1m) EXCLUDED from net debt, and D&A for the tax line is ex right-of-use depreciation (561.4 - 34.9 = 526.5, 8.4% of revenue). Net debt A$423.3m ties to the company's own reported net debt. EBITDA: the model's adj_ebitda is PRE-SBC (reported normalised EBITDA A$2,628.9m + SBC A$67.5m = A$2,696.4m, 42.8%) so SBC is an explicit line; owner EBITDA after SBC equals the reported 41.7%. FCF BASE: continuing operations only -- Plarium stub OCF (A$63.6m, note 4-4) removed; the A$456.2m Plarium gain and A$109.4m Big Fish charge are non-cash/one-off and outside the component build. TAX: 28% flat cash rate (FY2025 cash tax A$555.9m / normalised PBT A$1,966.1m = 28.3%; normalised ETR 27.7%); FY2020's A$1,018m deferred-tax benefit is not repeatable and is not used. D&A path declines 8.4% -> 7.5% as acquired-intangible amortisation (A$184m FY2025, finite life) runs off; only the tax shield is affected. WORKING CAPITAL: negative capture (-12% of revenue growth): B2B receivables-led business (NWC 5.8% of revenue, FY2025 outflow A$136m on A$624m growth = -22%; FY2024 -A$110m). NCI: none material. Anchors are 12 months old -- the H1 FY2026 result (May-2026) is not in the folder; refresh shares, net debt and FY2026 guidance from it and from the FY2026 annual (Nov-2026).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026 guidance (NPATA growth high-single-digit constant-currency) and FY2025 continuing constant-currency revenue growth of 7.6%; equity CAGR rejected as the anchor
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 15.6% vs revenue 5yr 8.8%: diverges >30%. Equity 5yr is inflated by the FY2020 base (A$1,018m one-off deferred-tax asset recognised in equity via profit) and equity 3yr (2.9%) is depressed by A$2.4bn of buybacks since FY2022 -- book value is not a usable growth anchor for a repurchaser. EPS CAGRs are also distorted: FY2020 EPS carries the deferred-tax benefit and FY2025 EPS carries the A$456m Plarium gain (continuing diluted EPS was 188.7c, not 261.5c).
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - IFRS 16 lease principal (leases were opex before FY2020, so no adjustment FY2016-19). Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR 15.7% is slightly ABOVE reported 14.7%: SBC has been flat-to-down in dollars while FCF compounded, so none of the growth was paid for in stock. Revenue CAGRs understate like-for-like growth because FY2025 is continuing-only (Plarium, ~A$930m FY2024 revenue, divested Feb-2025) while FY2020-24 include it; the restated FY2024 continuing base is A$5,673.4m, giving +11.0% reported / +7.6% constant-currency for FY2025. FY2020 is a COVID trough for revenue. Guidance-anchored 7% is the growth used for year 1.

scenario_narratives.bear: Deceleration compounds: the Apollo-backed Everi/IGT Gaming combination wins floor share in North American Gaming Operations, social casino keeps shrinking (-9% market, DAU 1.9m and falling) with Product Madness unable to offset via share gains, and an Apple/Google policy change or adverse gambling-classification ruling cuts social-casino economics. AUD strength reverses the FY2025 translational tailwind. Revenue grows 2-2.5%, pre-SBC EBITDA margin compresses from 42.8% to 39% by year 5, capex stays elevated at 7.5% to defend the installed base, terminal growth 2%.
scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 lands on guidance (high-single-digit constant-currency NPATA growth, second-half weighted) and growth decays from 7% toward 3% over ten years. Gaming holds its ~43% North American installed-base share and keeps winning Outright Sales on new titles (Spooky Link, Baron, Phoenix Link) plus HHR/VLT/COAM adjacencies; Interactive scales with iLottery wins (Michigan, Massachusetts) and Awager; Product Madness gains share in a shrinking market with margin expansion from disciplined UA and direct-to-consumer. Pre-SBC EBITDA margin drifts up 1pp to 43.8% as Interactive matures and Big Fish casual drag is gone. Capex 7.0%, tax 28%, terminal growth 3%, terminal value capped at 15x FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: All three segments outperform simultaneously: North American Gaming Operations installed base keeps adding 4-7k units a year while share holds against the Everi/IGT entity; Interactive sustains 30%+ growth into a still-expanding US iGaming/iLottery market; social casino stabilises and Product Madness converts share gains into margin. AUD stays weak. Revenue grows 10% in FY2026 fading to 3.5% by year 10, pre-SBC EBITDA margin reaches 46%, capex 6.8%, terminal growth 3.5%, terminal value capped at 15x.

entry_price.method: price at which PV of 10 interim owner FCFs at 15% + terminal value BUILT AT 15% (min(Gordon@15%, 15x FCF_10)) discounted at 15%, less net debt, per fully diluted share; per scenario, then probability-weighted

required_return_table.note: each row rebuilds terminal value at that row's rate: min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_10); 9.5% row = base intrinsic value, 15% row = base entry price

sensitivity.note: rows = WACC, columns = terminal growth; TV = min(Gordon, 15x FCF_10) rebuilt per cell

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20% (above the 15% house default): the social-casino tail risks are binary and outside management's control -- Apple/Google platform policy, gambling-classification class actions in the US and Australia -- and sit on top of a credible competitive threat (Everi/IGT under Apollo) and an FX exposure that flattered FY2025. Base 55%: FY2026 guidance is qualitative but the Gaming franchise (43% NA installed-base share, 18 of the top 25 premium leased games) is durable and the balance sheet (0.2x net debt/EBITDA) removes solvency from the downside. Bull 25% (below the 35% default): the bull case needs three independent things to go right at once -- Gaming share held against a larger consolidated rival, Interactive scaling to a profit contributor, and social casino stabilising -- plus the AUD staying weak.
probability_weighted.band_note: SBC is only 1.1% of revenue so the house/street band is narrow (~A$3/share); the price sits far above BOTH bases -- the gap to price is not an SBC-treatment question, it is the multiple (market EV ~27x owner FCF vs a 15x terminal cap and 9.5% WACC).

FY2025.component_rebuild_fy2025_unlevered: EBITDA pre-SBC 2696.4 - SBC 67.5 - lease 65.5 - D&A ex-ROU 526.5 = EBIT 2036.9; x(1-28%) = 1466.6; + D&A 526.5 - capex 458.3 + NWC -136.3 = 1398.5 unlevered owner FCF (22.2% of revenue). Levered owner FCF 1299.5 + after-tax net interest ~50 = ~1350; the residual ~50 is cash-tax timing and JV dividends (93.6 received vs 66.7 equity-accounted). Year-1 projected margin 23.8% sits above this because the WC drag is modelled at -12% of growth rather than FY2025's -22%.

data_quality_flags: Anchors are the FY2025 annual report (30-Sep-2025). The H1 FY2026 result (published May-2026) is not in the research folder; the live share count, net debt and any guidance revision are unverified as of 2026-09-21.
FY2020 net income (A$1,377.7m) and FY2025 statutory net income (A$1,640.3m incl. A$456.2m Plarium gain) are not used anywhere in the forward build.
FX held flat; AUD appreciation is the single largest non-operating swing factor (~A$27m NPATA per US cent).

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
